services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Host your next event at one of Manhattan’s most unique private event venues. Invite your guests to delight in an exclusive tour or tasting, enjoy a bespoke meal curated by our culinary team, and sip cocktails crafted by New York’s premier mixologists. Overlooking Broadway, our third floor lounge is not just our highest, but also our most intimate and versatile room in the house. Featuring a library, projector screen, and private service bar, it’s ideally suited for business and private gatherings alike. services.name: Distillery Tours
services.desc: We’re bringing the craft of whiskey distilling back to Manhattan, and you’re invited to experience it all with us. Let our experts guide you through the rich world of whiskey’s past and present, in a warm setting full of brilliant sights, sounds and flavors. We source our grain from the Black Dirt region in Warwick Valley, NY where the air, climate, and rich soil impart a distinctive flavor profile on the ingredients. These unique notes are illuminated as our whiskeys distill in our home at 686 Broadway, and are featured throughout our cocktail classes, whiskey tastings, food pairing courses, and more.
